summary: Detects missing published-package version bumps locally before the first push and protected CI run.

instructions: Reinstall EnterpriseGlue Dev Workflows 0.1.7 to use the updated new-change and ship guidance.

documentation: The contributor release-note process and versioned EnterpriseGlue workflow skills now require the package guard before commit and again before push.
rollback: Revert the guard and workflow guidance; no application or database rollback is required.
validation: A disposable Git fixture proves the guard rejects an uncommitted published-package source change without a version bump and accepts it after the manifest is corrected.
The versioned EnterpriseGlue plugin and all bundled skills pass their repository validators.
